ambient_events: Water moves somewhere behind the back wall, unhurried, going nowhere good.
The roller door rattles once in its housing as something heavy goes past outside.
A patch of plaster comes away from the mirror scars and lands soft on the floor.
Two voices haggle on the pavement outside, too low to make out, too long to be honest.
description: A square, low-ceilinged shop that used to do nails and then did something else. The mirrors have been taken off the wall and their adhesive has taken the plaster with them. A counter runs across the back, and beside it a strongbox is chained to a steel upright that was clearly put there for the purpose. It smells faintly of acetone and more strongly of damp.
name: Unit 9, Marrow Street
